# PHASE-006 - Enforce guards in the owning action paths

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Plan | `PLAN-20260909-4B15BB49` |
| Phase status | `planned` |
| Depends on | PHASE-005 |

## Objective

Cover all delivered mutation families without replacing their authority or transactions.

## Scope

- Action schemas and exact decisions
- Owner-specific adapters
- Bootstrap/recovery and observed coverage

## Entry conditions

- Rule/shape validation and exact publication interfaces are working.

## Exit criteria

- Every supported family has an actual guarded dispatch path with failure and stale-state evidence.
- Enabled failures never invoke a mutation continuation; disabled/uncovered states remain visible.

## Risks

- There is no existing shared dispatcher; wrapper-only validation is inadequate.
- Upgrades can invalidate the guard itself and need exact retained recovery semantics.

## TASK-024 - Implement exact semantic guard decisions

Add reusable guard evaluation and continuation binding over normalized input, current target, ontology/rules/sources and authority-context identity.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_guards.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_guard_engine.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-023, TASK-013 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- No cached pass may authorize changed work; never claim cross-helper atomicity.

### Acceptance criteria

- Invalid, ambiguous, stale, unsupported, timed-out or unavailable enabled checks fail closed.
- Changed arguments, target revision, governing hash, rule or manager generation invalidate a prior decision.
- Semantic success, operational authorization, execution and post-verification are separately represented.

### Planned verification

- Inject every failure class and assert the mutation continuation is never invoked.
- Change each bound input between check and dispatch and verify revalidation or rejection.
